item.name: Admin
item.description: Cookie-authenticated catalogue operations. Login captures the CSRF cookie for mutating requests.

request.description: Creates an expiring server-side admin session. Credentials are injected as secret environment values.
Resolves the current active admin session.
Returns active and inactive categories for management. POST and PATCH use the same resource with the CSRF header.
Returns exact stock and reservation counts for catalogue management. POST creates a product; GET/PATCH by UUID edit it; the archive action performs archival.

exec: pm.test('returns exact inventory', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.items[0].variants[0]).to.have.property('stock_on_hand'); });

request.description: Creates a short-lived, product-scoped signed direct-upload request without returning the Cloudinary API secret. Disabled by default.

exec: pm.test('does not expose the API secret', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('signature_algorithm', 'sha256'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('api_secret'); });

request.description: Verifies Cloudinary's response signature and registers trusted photo metadata. Supply values from a completed direct upload. Disabled by default.

exec: pm.test('returns trusted metadata', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.url.startsWith('https://res.cloudinary.com/')).to.eql(true); pm.environment.set('admin_product_image_id', body.id); });
